jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, and helping organizations strengthen their security posture? Do you want hands-on experience in a global company where security, compliance, and modern infrastructure are essential for delivering reliable solutions to customers worldwide?

We are looking for interns to join our Customer IT Infrastructure Solutions (CITIS) department at BEUMER Group. As part of the team, you will work alongside experienced specialists and gain practical experience with cybersecurity, hardening, compliance, automation, and infrastructure technologies in international customer environments.One team

In CITIS, we help design, implement, secure and maintain IT infrastructure solutions for customers around the world. As a cybersecurity intern, you will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you will work on real-world challenges alongside skilled colleagues. Your tasks could be:

• 
Supporting cybersecurity assessments and compliance activities based on frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks and IEC 62443

• 
Participating in hardening and security improvement initiatives for servers, databases, virtual environments and infrastructure platforms Assisting with vulnerability management, security reviews and risk mitigation activities

• 
Developing and improving technical documentation, security guidelines and operational procedures

• 
Working with automation tools such as PowerShell and Power Automate to streamline security and infrastructure processes

• 
Supporting customer projects involving Microsoft, VMware, SQL Server and cloud technologies Collaborating with specialists across cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and project teams

" The best part of my internship was being trusted with real responsibilities and projects that made a tangible impact. From cybersecurity assessments and compliance work to automation and documentation, I was able to apply knowledge from my studies while learning from experienced colleagues who were always willing to help and share their expertise." – Rumena,  Cyber Security Student Worker (intern of 20_26_)

Valued and equal member of the team
As an intern at CITIS, you will be treated as a valued member of the team and be involved in meaningful projects from day one. You will gain practical experience applying cybersecurity principles in real customer environments while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The internship offers a unique opportunity to work with modern security practices, learn from experienced colleagues, and understand how cybersecurity, operational requirements, and business needs must be balanced in large-scale IT environments.

The internship is paid and lasts appr. 5 months - the exact period will be agreed with your manager. Please apply online via the link as soon as possible, and no later than October 23rd. We will interview candidates on an ongoing basis and may hire candidates before the application deadline.
Please attach a copy of your recent grade sheet.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Head of Global CITIS, Kim Rokkjær, at +45 4051 9500 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm at +45 3176 0448.
We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

You will develop and drive the regional vertical strategy, helping customers address challenges related to energy efficiency, sustainability, and system performance. jobs.description:
3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).

The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?

Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.

The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.

The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).

The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

You will:

• 
Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.

• 
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.

• 
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.

• 
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.

• 
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.

• 
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.

• 
Design and run simulation studies to validate theoretical developments under realistic conditions.

• 
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to integrate new methods into production-oriented 3D scanning systems.

• 
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and potential patentable innovations.

What We’re Looking For

• 
A PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. The PhD must have been awarded after March 2021 (or will be obtained within November 2026).

• 
Strong expertise in numerical linear algebra, optimization, and/or inverse problems.

• 
Solid understanding of linear least squares methods and iterative solvers, ideally methods based on Krylov subspace methods.

• 
Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.

• 
Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.

• 
Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.

• 
Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Job Description

Can you turn complex data into decisions that shape the future of offshore wind?

At Vattenfall, there is a way. A way to accelerate the energy transition through innovation, collaboration and smart decision-making. As a Wind Farm System Designer, you will help define the design and value of some of Europe's largest offshore wind projects, influencing investment decisions worth billions of euros and contributing directly to a more sustainable energy system.

Business Area Wind

Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms both onshore and offshore to accelerate the growth of renewable energy. We bring together international expertise, technological innovation and operational excellence to deliver world-class energy projects that support the transition to a more sustainable future.

Our System Design team combines engineering, economics, costing, sustainability and data science competencies. Investigating innovative technologies, regulatory framework, cost and price projections, we identify opportunities across Vattenfall's offshore wind portfolio from early stage of wind farm development to repowering.

Your role / what will you do?

As a student worker in Wind Farm System Design, you will support experienced specialists in developing data-driven insights for offshore wind farm design. You will help prepare analyses, structure input data, maintain reporting material, and contribute to levelized energy cost (LEC) related improvement initiatives that support better technical and commercial solutions.

Key Responsibilities

LEC Performance & Improvement Work

• Support LEC performance reporting by analysis updating datasets, preparing visual material, and contributing to quarterly reporting to management, and creating dashboards.

• Contribute to LEC improvement work by helping structure ideas, track progress, and translate technical or commercial concepts into clear material for further evaluation.

Offshore Intelligence & Insights

• 
Support the preparation of independent offshore intelligence reports by collecting, structuring, and analysing information on market trends, cost drivers, and value-engineering opportunities across the offshore wind lifecycle.

• 
Assist with deep-dive consulting analyses by preparing datasets, building simple models or summaries, and turning findings into clear presentations or decision-support material.

Business Travel

Limited travel within Northwest Europe may be required, but the role is primarily expected to be office-based and compatible with studies.

Location

Kolding, Denmark

Qualifications

Your profile / who are you?

We believe you'll be successful in this role if you:

• Are studying for a Master's degree or a PHD in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or another relevant field.

• Have strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to convert complex information into business insights and recommendations.

• Have an interest in renewable energy and the energy transition.

• Have an interest in Python and applying AI-enabled tools.

• communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

• Knowledge of tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL or comparable data and analytics platforms.

More information

• Start date: As soon as possible

• Flexible 2-4 days/week, max. 15 hours/week

• Minimum: 12 months

• Location: Kolding

• You will work in an international team, where you will have colleagues placed at different locations across our core countries.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than, October 22nd 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.
